$bog_smalljs_landing_Feature1_text_text: An incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a single component and a full-stack local-first app.
$bog_smalljs_landing_Feature2_text_text: Build UIs as trees of components. Reactivity is automatic, side-effects are explicit.
$bog_smalljs_landing_Feature3_text_text: Full rendering virtualization — components outside the viewport simply do not exist.
$bog_smalljs_landing_Hero_subtitle_note_: Dependency arrays, manual subscriptions, manual cache invalidation, effect cleanup — none of it exists here. Not made easier, made unnecessary.
$bog_smalljs_landing_Hero_subtitle_text: Reactivity lives in the framework's foundation, not bolted on top.
$bog_smalljs_landing_Sign_caption_text: Three files: the markup, the logic and the styles.
$bog_smalljs_landing_arch_line_text: A project is a folder, a folder is a repository, and the framework sits next to your code instead of inside it. The layout is the same for a first component and for a company with thirty of them.

$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_css: The styles — TypeScript calling $mol_style_define, so property names are checked by the compiler.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_entry: The page that mounts the component. Only a module you actually deploy needs one.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_framework: $mol itself, cloned on the first build. Its source sits next to yours: read it, put a debugger in it, open a pull request from the same working copy.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_gitattribute: One line, "* -text", switching off end-of-line normalisation. Deployment commits the build output, and fonts and images have to survive that commit intact.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_package: Your own package: one short folder that holds every project you start, and a git repository of its own.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_project: A project: a folder that is also a repository of its own. Its history belongs to it, not to your package and not to $mol.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_registry: Maps a package name to a repository. When the build meets $mol_view and there is no mol/ folder yet, it clones the repo listed here.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_registry_own: The same registry one level down. Every project you add gets a pack line here, so a fresh checkout of your package fetches the projects too.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_submodule: A folder inside a module is a nested component: my/hello/form/ is $my_hello_form. There is no import to write, the path is the name.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_tree: The layout. The file name and the folder path together give the component its name: my/hello/hello.view.tree is $my_hello.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_ts: The behaviour: a class extending the base that the tree generates.
$bog_smalljs_structure_hint_workspace: The MAM checkout. You clone it once and every project lives inside it — nothing is ever copied in, each package is a git checkout of its own.
$bog_smalljs_structure_step1_text: Clone MAM once. It is the workspace every project lives in.
$bog_smalljs_structure_step2_text: Make one short folder for yourself and push it as a repository.
$bog_smalljs_structure_step3_text: Add the registry of your projects next to it.
$bog_smalljs_structure_step4_text: Create the project inside, with a repository of its own.
$bog_smalljs_structure_step5_text: Register it, so a fresh checkout fetches it by name.
$bog_smalljs_structure_steps_title: Five steps to a project of your own
$bog_smalljs_structure_why_text:
MAM copies nothing into itself. Every folder in the workspace is a git checkout in its own right: your package, your project, and the framework beside them. The registry only maps a module name to a repository, so the build knows where to fetch a module from the first time it meets one.

Two things follow. The framework source lies next to your code, so you can read it, put a breakpoint in it and send a pull request from the same working copy. And your project stays cloneable on its own, by someone who has never heard of MAM.

[MAM: front-end builds without the pain](https://habhub.hyoo.ru/#!author=nin-jin/repo=HabHub/article=18) — the long version, from the author. In Russian.
$bog_smalljs_structure_why_title: Why your project is a repository of its own
